name: Shezmu permissionless collateral mint
summary: A WBTC collateral input token exposed mint(address,uint256) without caller authorization. The attacker minted arbitrary collateral, deposited it into the vault, and borrowed unbacked ShezUSD.

loss.notes: Two receipts in the bounded seven-nonce campaign depleted the ShezUSD/USDC pool by exactly 639,740.960319 + 42,926.569474 = 682,667.529793 USDC, with no campaign USDC input or return. The first receipt's same-block MEV transaction returned 76,500.771328 USDC to the pool while removing 122,736.557154824572663770 ShezUSD; those unrelated flows explain the block-level archive residual and are excluded from this campaign. The attacker-created 18-decimal pseudo-WBTC and freshly issued ShezUSD are unbacked consideration retained by the protocol or pool, not additional priceable victim outflows. Downstream WETH/ETH disposal and later negotiated recovery are excluded from exploit-time gross loss. Same-day recurrence by a second actor (USDC and sDAI components): Four disposal receipts depleted the Curve ShezUSD/USDC pool by 962.224781 + 118.616729 + 142.949383 = 1,223.790893 USDC and the Balancer ShezUSD/sDAI pool by 771.270672279107347817 + 92.720177612173316782 = 863.990849891280664599 sDAI. Each receipt exactly matches the corresponding archive pool-balance delta, with no same-block residual. The two sDAI components are valued at their closest-preceding ERC-4626 DAI conversion values and DAI par. The freely minted pseudo-WBTC and ShezUSD are unbacked pool consideration, not additional scarce-asset loss. Downstream WETH/ETH disposal, retained unbacked ShezUSD, and later return activity are excluded.

ageReset.description: The permissionless mint path is part of the token's immutable direct runtime, deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit.

sources.note: Archive-RPC review bounded sender nonces 566 through 572. Nonce 566 minted 700,000.000000000000000233 pseudo-WBTC from zero, deposited it in the lending path, minted 693,000.000000000000000231 ShezUSD, and delivered 693,000.000000000000000229 ShezUSD to the Curve pool for 639,740.960319 USDC. Nonces 567 and 568 are native coordination transfers with no token flow. Nonces 569 and 570 repeated the unbacked collateral/issuance path and left 1,386,000.000000000000000462 ShezUSD with the sender; nonce 571 approved it. Nonce 572 delivered another 693,000.000000000000000230 ShezUSD to the pool for 42,926.569474 USDC. The first drain block moves the pool from 653,923.773006 to 90,683.584015 USDC and from 337,877.794552517281849382 to 908,141.237397692709185841 ShezUSD: the two incident and MEV receipts reconcile the exact -563,240.188991-USDC and +570,263.442845175427336459-ShezUSD block deltas. The second drain block moves it from 43,967.518143 to 1,040.948669 USDC and from 967,007.595620487426737878 to 1,660,007.595620487426738108 ShezUSD, exactly matching that receipt. The helper begins and ends with zero ETH and unchanged 4-wei USDC/1-wei WETH dust, plus only 2 wei ShezUSD; pseudo-WBTC and ShezUSD inflation are not scarce-asset depletion. Adjacent nonce 565 does not touch the incident system, while nonce 573 begins later negotiation; subsequent disposal and recovery do not alter gross loss. The sole implicated defect is the public mint path in direct runtime 0x641249db01d5c9a04d1a223765ffd15f95167924. It was created at 20666529:69, is absent in the prior block, has unchanged pre-incident hash 0x636790363efd966d1c8e3e2459ffcfa5c9729e00b719e5adacb9af494df81673, and contains no delegation. Its age at the first drain is 1,536,624 seconds.

Archive-RPC review bounded the funding transaction and attacker nonces 0 through 7. Nonce 0 created an ephemeral helper and used the same public mint path as the earlier Shezmu campaign to issue 340,282,366,920,938,463,463.374607431768211455 pseudo-WBTC and 98,999,168,398.02 ShezUSD without scarce collateral. Nonce 1 approved ShezUSD. Nonces 2, 3, 5 and 6 routed unbacked ShezUSD through the two victim pools; nonce 4 moved only unbacked ShezUSD, and nonce 7 returned native funding and ends the bounded campaign. Curve USDC archive deltas are exactly -962.224781, -118.616729 and -142.949383 in the three receipts, while its corresponding ShezUSD inputs are 5,400,000, 10,000,000 and 10,000,000. Balancer pool 0xed0df9cd16d806e8a523805e53cf0c56e6db4d1d000000000000000000000687 falls from 788.853467591609980624 to 17.582795312502632807 sDAI against 4,600,000 ShezUSD in nonce 2, then from 96.652092844373340954 to 3.931915232200024172 sDAI against 10,000,000 ShezUSD in nonce 6. ERC-4626 convertToAssets(1e18) at the preceding blocks is 1.109176937108462931 DAI and 1.109191840595421389 DAI respectively. The exploit helper ends with zero ETH and incident-token balances; routing helper 0xf081470f5c6fbccf48cc4e5b82dd926409dcdd67 retains only its unchanged 1-wei ShezUSD, USDC, sDAI and WETH dust and 48 additional wei of ETH. Uniswap WETH outputs are downstream disposal of the measured victim assets, not additional loss. The incident anchor is nonce 0 at 20794865:155, the earliest successful transaction in this campaign to execute the public mint defect; the first scarce loss follows at nonce 2, 20794884:104. The target is the same direct runtime and selector path as the earlier campaign. It was created at 20666529:69, is absent in the preceding block, has unchanged hash 0x636790363efd966d1c8e3e2459ffcfa5c9729e00b719e5adacb9af494df81673 and contains no delegation. Its age at the causal anchor is 1,548,240 seconds.

Merged the same-day recurrence into this record. Three hours after the anchor an unrelated actor (0xa3a64255..., 0xed4b3d46..., 0xf081470f...) used the identical permissionless mint path on the same collateral token (anchor source-8, campaign set source-11) and removed 1223.790893 USDC and 863.990849891280664599 sDAI from the ShezUSD pools. A copycat exploitation of code already shown vulnerable is more loss from the same fault, not a second failure, so those components and attacker addresses join this record while the age stays measured at the first exploit. Its review is source-10.

notes: A second, unrelated actor repeated the exploit three hours later (transaction 0x39328ea4377a8887d3f6ce91b2f4c6b19a851e2fc5163e2f83bbc2fc136d0c71); that recurrence is merged here as the 1223.79 USDC and 863.99 sDAI components.
